info.name: Lokal Base API Tests
info.description:
Comprehensive API test suite for Lokal Base application.

## Setup Instructions
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Set the `baseUrl` variable (default: http://localhost:3000)
3. Run the Auth > Register and Login tests first to set up authentication
4. Replace `placeholder_route_id` and `placeholder_stop_id` with real IDs from your database

## Running Tests
- Run the entire collection using Collection Runner
- Or run individual folders/requests as needed
- Auth tests should run first to set tokens for protected endpoints
